anomalies: celeste:sides-hearts:core-crystal-heart — src-tracker-maps carries no crystal-heart pin anywhere in Core, so this cell is sourced from src-ink-collectables ("The Crystal Heart and the Cassette Tape are located at the end of the level, collecting them is necessary to complete it") rather than from a pin like the other seven hearts. Same gap already recorded against the spine layer.

celeste:sides-hearts:core-a-side — Core's A-Side clear is the one cell in the A-Side column with no corresponding achievement. The eight chapter-clear achievements cover chapters 1-6, The Summit ("Celeste — Climb Celeste Mountain") and Farewell ("Farewell — Complete Chapter 9"); Core's A-Side is required to reach the crystal heart and cassette but awards nothing itself. Sourced from src-ink-chapters and the level-clear pin instead.

notes: Deck slot 1 (matrix, Sides & Hearts, global). Composition approved by Pierre 2026-07-30.

Rows are the eight chapters that have alternate sides — Forsaken City through Core. Prologue, Epilogue and Farewell have no B- or C-Side (src-ink-chapters: alternate sides "exist in every chapter except Prologue, Epilogue and Farewell") so they are not rows here; their clears live in the Achievements checklist and the route.
Row labels carry the in-game chapter number, so Core reads "Ch 8: Core" while its pack index is 9. The two numberings disagree throughout the sources; the spine layer records the same convention.

24 of the 32 cells correspond one-to-one with an achievement in src-ink-achievements: 7 A-Side clears, 8 crystal hearts, 8 B-Side clears, and Core's A-Side which has none. The 8 C-Side cells map collectively to the single "Thanks For Playing" achievement rather than one each.
No flagged cells. Every cell is corroborated by a level-clear or crystal-heart pin in src-tracker-maps except Core's crystal heart, which the pack omits — see anomalies.
